_about: Darwell Stone (1859-1941), Anglo-Catholic theologian, Principal of Pusey House; his books published before 1931; from Adam's Libronix inventory; Internet Archive OCR, raw; title, edition and imprint read from each scan's title page, 2026-11-03. Added by lane A. No uids minted. All pre-1931 publications, so US public domain.

stone-holy-baptism: Holy Baptism, Oxford Library of Practical Theology, new impression (London: Longmans, Green, 1917)
stone-outlines-dogma: Outlines of Christian Dogma (London: Longmans, Green, 1900)

stone-invocation-saints: The Invocation of Saints (London: Longmans, Green, 1903)
stone-bearing-church-history: The Bearing of Church History on the Proposed Representative Church Council (Oxford: James Parker, 1904)
stone-holy-communion: The Holy Communion, Oxford Library of Practical Theology (London: Longmans, Green, 1904)
stone-eucharist-history-1: A History of the Doctrine of the Holy Eucharist, vol. I (London: Longmans, Green, 1909)
stone-eucharist-history-2: A History of the Doctrine of the Holy Eucharist, vol. II (London: Longmans, Green, 1909)
stone-reserved-sacrament: The Reserved Sacrament, Handbooks of Catholic Faith and Practice (London: Robert Scott, 1917)
stone-eucharistic-sacrifice: The Eucharistic Sacrifice, Handbooks of Catholic Faith and Practice (London: Robert Scott, 1920)
stone-who-are-members: Who Are Members of the Church? (with F. W. Puller), Pusey House Occasional Papers 9 (London: Longmans, Green, 1921)
stone-faith-english-catholic: The Faith of an English Catholic (London: Longmans, Green, 1926)
